execution_assumptions.entry: first available 5-minute bar at or after Monday 08:00 Europe/Warsaw
execution_assumptions.scheduled_exit: first available 5-minute bar at or after Friday 22:00 Europe/Warsaw
execution_assumptions.slippage: not included in live paper log; validation report includes transaction-cost assumptions

rationale_pl: NO TRADE — obserwuję trigger do otwarcia pozycji. WES otworzy pozycję tylko po nowym, wystarczająco silnym i potwierdzonym sygnale; nic na siłę.
Siła sygnału jest wskaźnikiem heurystycznym, a nie prawdopodobieństwem powodzenia.
Zmienność wpływa na score i poziomy ryzyka zapisane przed otwarciem.
rationale_en: NO TRADE — monitoring for an entry trigger. WES will open only after a new, sufficiently strong and confirmed signal; no forced exposure.
Signal strength is heuristic, not a probability of success.
Volatility affects the score and risk levels frozen before entry.

macro_context.rule: Oil and US10Y are context inputs, not standalone trade triggers.
Oil and US10Y are context inputs, not standalone trade triggers.

entry_price_plan.fill_rule: MARKET mode fills only on a fresh completed post-decision 5m bar verified by EPE. LIMIT mode fills only when the frozen target is touched. Persistent LIMIT reaffirmation may extend time but may never move the frozen target. No analytical or retroactive price may be fabricated.

latest_macro_context.rule: Context is recorded immediately; an open weekly position is changed only by the governed review rules.
